subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No unit tests were added for the new live_preview configuration. The existing test file already tests the `options` object (e.g., the 'contentstack fetch timeout' describe block at ~line 155 uses `require('../contentstack.ts')` and asserts on `testedModule.options`), but a search for 'live_preview|CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW|livePreview' across the test file returned zero matches. Per review criterion 2, new features must have corresponding vitest unit tests. Three test scenarios are expected: (1) live_preview block present with enable=true, host, and management_token when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE='true' and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN is set; (2) live_preview absent from options when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE is not 'true'; (3) live_preview.host uses CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST when set, falling back to the default when unset.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a new describe block (e.g., 'contentstack live_preview') to src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts that sets process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE, CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST, and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN, requires the module, and asserts on testedModule.options.live_preview — following the exact pattern already used by the 'contentstack fetch timeout' tests.

issues.description: Hardcoded endpoint URL 'api.contentstack.io' used as fallback for CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST. Per review criterion 6, no hardcoded strings for endpoint URLs — all must use named constants from src/config/constants.ts. A search of src/config for 'api.contentstack.io' returned no matches, confirming this string is not already defined as a constant.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a named constant (e.g., CONTENTSTACK_DEFAULT_PREVIEW_HOST = 'api.contentstack.io') to src/config/constants.ts and import it in contentstack.ts, replacing the inline string literal.
